firm_data.firm_description: Access Justice Brooklyn partners with compassionate pro bono attorneys to provide high-quality, civil legal services that help ensure equal access to the legal system. The organization’s approach prioritizes the most basic, essential elements and experiences of human life, including housing, family stability, and subsistence income.
notable_facts: Access Justice Brooklyn is a charity partner of the 2026 TD Five Boro Bike Tour.
Provides civil legal services to low-income Brooklynites, especially in marginalized communities.
Offers training and supervision to volunteers.

email.subject: AI for Access Justice Brooklyn, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Lilia,

Your work ensuring equal access to housing and family legal services across Brooklyn caught my attention, especially as you scale impact with pro bono partnerships. That depth of commitment requires both precision and efficiency.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing complex caseloads with lean teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: client trust, case accuracy, and time back for the work that matters most.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet organizations doing civil legal work. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how we're helping similar firms compete and serve more clients without adding overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
